target_customer: Restaurant owners and operators in the Horeca sector, mainly in Spain
problem: Restaurants lose margin because supplier prices, invoices and recipe costs are tracked by hand. haddock digitizes invoices and gives cost control, later adding AI agents for operations.
product_category: Restaurant back office and operations software

founders.name: Arnau Navarro
previous_startups: YC page calls him a 3x founder from Barcelona; earlier ventures not named
founders.background_notes: Interests listed as foodtech, B2B SaaS, fintech and go-to-market.

founders.name: Pol Rosell
education: Studied economics in Barcelona (per YC page, school not named)
founders.background_notes: YC page says he bridges business vision and technology.

competitors.name: MarketMan
competitors.what: Restaurant inventory, invoice scanning and recipe costing software
competitors.traction_then: Listed on Capterra Spain with 112 reviews (undated page)

competitors.name: Apicbase
competitors.what: Food costing and inventory management for restaurant groups
competitors.traction_then: Listed on Capterra Spain with 35 reviews (undated page)

technical_complexity.rationale: Invoice OCR, supplier price tracking and linking purchases to sales data is standard engineering with hard document extraction work for a small team.

defensibility.rationale: Invoice and price history could lock in customers, but food cost tools were widely available and OCR was becoming commodity.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No acquisition or copying found in sources. haddock reports itself as Spain market leader and launched AI agents.

market_need_then: Restaurant margins and supplier price changes are a recognized pain, and haddock's site frames the product as a control point for margins. No independent 2022 evidence was opened.

branding.domain_note: Uses haddock.app, not a .com; history not found.

identity.voice_and_tone: Direct, imperative Spanish, informal 'tu', practical profit focus, for example 'Ten tu margen bajo control'

brand_strength.rationale: Brand search found no origin story or brand press. Voice is clear on the company site but evidence of recognition is thin.

pivots.from: Invoice digitization and food cost control for restaurants
pivots.to: Restaurant operations platform with AI agents
pivots.why: Site and YC description now present a system of record plus AI agents; date and reason not stated

outcome_analysis: haddock is active with about 40 people per the YC listing and has moved from food cost control toward a restaurant operations platform with AI agents. The only funding evidence is a seed of about 1M euros around the YC batch, and no later round was found, so the trajectory and outcome remain unclear.
